info.name: FlavorDB API - Complete Collection
info.description: Complete Postman collection for FlavorDB API with all 40 endpoints, authorization, and examples. Ready to import and use.

item.name: Property Controller
item.description: APIs for regulatory and industry classification data for flavor molecules

item.name: Properties By Taste Threshold
item.description: Finds molecules based on their taste detection threshold values. Use when researching how potent different flavor compounds are.

item.name: Entity Controller
item.description: APIs for food items and ingredients (entities) in the database

item.name: Entities By Natural Source
item.description: Finds all foods or ingredients that come from a specific natural source. Use when researching what foods share the same natural origin or source.

request.description: Finds all foods or ingredients that come from a specific natural source. Use when researching what foods share the same natural origin or source.

item.name: Entities By Name And Category
item.description: Searches for foods or ingredients by their name and category type. Use when you need to find specific foods within a particular category (like fruits, vegetables, meats, etc.).

request.description: Searches for foods or ingredients by their name and category type. Use when you need to find specific foods within a particular category (like fruits, vegetables, meats, etc.).

item.name: Entities By Readable Name
item.description: Searches for foods using their common, everyday names. Use when you want to look up a food using the name people actually use (like 'apple' instead of scientific names).

request.description: Searches for foods using their common, everyday names. Use when you want to look up a food using the name people actually use (like 'apple' instead of scientific names).

item.name: Food Pairing Controller
item.description: APIs for discovering food pairings and flavor combinations

item.name: Flavor Pairings by Ingredient
item.description: Finds a food item by its name and returns similar foods that pair well with it. Use when you want to discover what foods go well together or find pairing suggestions for a specific food item.

request.description: Finds a food item by its name and returns similar foods that pair well with it. Use when you want to discover what foods go well together or find pairing suggestions for a specific food item.
